caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical glass positioned upright in the center of the composition. The glass is rendered in a deep, translucent red color, with darker shades along the sides and lighter highlights indicating reflection and transparency. The rim of the glass is shown with a slightly darker outline, and its circular top is visible. The bottom of the glass reveals a shaded base, indicating thickness and the effect of light passing through the red material. The background is a plain, light beige color, with some slightly darker, uneven shading near the edges. There is no additional object in the drawing, and the focus is entirely on the red glass. The artist's signature, "WHITE," is written in small letters below the glass.
title: Tumbler (Ruby)
